The Science Fiction Art of Wally Wood

Wally Wood changed science fiction illustration via his art in comics and magazines, particularly through his work with EC Comics and in Galaxy Science Fiction. His cinematic visuals and unique designs left a lasting impact on both comics and broader visual culture.

Born to Draw Horror: The Art of Frazer Irving

Frazer Irving’s art isn’t just something you look at; it’s something you feel. From Necronauts to Klarion the Witch Boy and Annihilator, his haunting visuals evoke a sense of dread and wonder, making him one of the true masters of horror in comics.

The Blog of Horror

Warped by a box full of horror comics at the tender age of five, scarred by illicit screenings of horror cinema classics under the auspices of negligent babysitters, LOD now disseminates horror film, fiction, and comic book commentary across the blogosphere. We dare you to share the darkness with us! Subscribe to the blog for extra horror content.
